items.title: Trump’s Tariff Refund Saved Lowe’s From An Earnings Miss. Here’s The Math On How Government Tariff Refunds Are Padding Retailers’ Profits
items.summary: Lowe's cleared Wall Street's bar last quarter, but one line in the release tells a different story. Court-ordered tariff refunds are flowing to retailers, not shoppers, and each company is spending the windfall differently.

items.title: Gap Inc. slashed its full-year sales outlook — and it might be due to the weather
items.summary:
The Gap Inc. (GAP) reported solid third quarter earnings results but cut its full-year sales outlook. The results came after a busy week of other retail earnings from Walmart (WMT) and Target (TGT).

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a closer look.

items.title: Walmart Is Up 183% in Five Years and Just Raised Guidance Again. Is There Room Left to Run?
items.summary: Walmart keeps beating estimates, yet a premium multiple that dwarfs Target's has skeptics circling. One overlooked profit engine growing several times faster than the stores may explain why Wall Street still isn't pricing the stock correctly.
